scenarios.name: api-storage-table-crud
scenarios.description: A .NET 10 Web API on Azure App Service performing full CRUD operations against Azure Storage Table with logistics-industry sample data and Swagger UI.

scenarios.name: azure-container-scenarios
scenarios.description: Comparative demo deploying a single Docker container across four Azure container hosting services (ACI, ACA, AKS, App Service) with shared ACR and unified monitoring.

scenarios.name: sentinel-threat-detection
scenarios.description: Microsoft Sentinel SIEM demo with dual signal sources — a vulnerable Windows VM and a .NET 10 Finance webapp — for SOC analyst training and threat detection workflows.

scenarios.name: linux-vm-ssh-nsg
scenarios.description: A single Ubuntu Linux VM with VNet, Subnet, NSG (SSH port 22), Public IP, and Log Analytics for monitoring. Demonstrates Azure IaaS networking with NSG rules.
